notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Update:
New store and 4 new gardenbeds.
These new items can be unlocked though the questline.

Fixes:
Updated game icon (was appearing as a black square)
Removed mouse positioning triggered by the tutorial boxes.

Other:
Downsized the minimap.

notes.title: Rooftop Garden Simulator in Early Access!
notes.content:
Today we are releasing Rooftop Garden Simulator.

To celebrate the release of our game, we run a 20% release discount!

After months of hard work we've got a great base for the early access version.
We are still in development, and will be releasing updates very often.

We would love to get in contact with you in the community hub.
Let us know what you think and how we can improve Rooftop Garden Simulator.

Happy farming!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481701/2d0f24869190f0369cb8cdcd47d8f2bf42a7c80b.png[/img]

notes.title: One week until release!
notes.content:
Hi!

We are one week from release and we've been making huge steps in developing Rooftop Garden Simulator.
Next Monday, August first, we are going live :)

A small sum up of what we've been working on:
New level
New questline
New items
Improved building and growing system
Small bug fixes.

Because our game has changed so much, we are discontinuing the demo next week.

Stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481701/2d0f24869190f0369cb8cdcd47d8f2bf42a7c80b.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo Release
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481701/9e6862f0a899d6ddb71b49f76aa7f5e92bda2876.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481701/a6f6ff5af6529c8a4120c8d9b05d5ded164120c6.png[/img][/url]

We can proudly tell you that the free to play demo of Rooftop Garden Simulator is live.
I hope you will enjoy this stripped down version of our game, and let us know in the hub!

Happy farming!

notes.title: Rooftop Garden Simulator Demo Announcement
notes.content:
Hi gamers,

We would like to share that Rooftop Garden Simulator is on schedule, and we are still aiming to release this summer. 
We’ve been working on several debug versions to test out all the back-end systems and we are almost ready for release.
Since our game has passed this fase, we wanted to release a free demo version.
This demo will be a compressed version of the full game, and will be released within the next few weeks for everyone to download on Steam.

We hope this demo version of Rooftop Garden Simulator will give you an idea of how the final game will become.

Kind Regards,
Guido - SoftStoneGames
